messages:
Maya (sec-eng): FYI Customer 'Peregrine' requested a compliance bundle for next-week review: RBAC change receipts, KMS unwrap events with tenant correlation, and an HSM attestation. Can infra pull samples?
Liam (infra): Yep. I'll export RBAC audit + our config-drift check. Prefer window 60d or 180d?
Maya (sec-eng): Ask for 90 days. They also want a single example of the dual-approval workflow for a role elevation.
Aria (customer-sre): Also ask to include SIEM ingestion confirmation (index + event count) and a short vuln triage note for CVE-2025-0777.
Omar (platform): For KMS unwraps we have an export script. Reminder to redact key material and tenant PII. Command we use:
```bash
./scripts/export_kms_logs --start 2024-11-01 --end 2025-02-28 --redact --out pereg_kms.jsonl
```
Liam (infra): I'll run the RBAC export and attach a sample with approval_id and approvers list. Example line:
{"ts":"2025-02-11T12:05:00Z","actor":"svc-deploy","target":"eve","prev_roles":["reader"],"new_roles":["deployer"],"approvals":["mgr_j","sec_ops_k"]}
Maya (sec-eng): Great. We also need to state our key custody model (envelope keys owned by platform, customer data keys ephemeral per-tenant) and point to HSM attestation. Omar, can you pull vendor attestation PDF?
Omar (platform): We have the vendor attestation (current) on file. I can include that and ask vendor for a short-stamped note referencing the export window if Peregrine requests it.
security-bot: Checklist created: security.packet.peregrine.3410002222 (rbac, kms_unwraps, siem_manifest, vuln_timeline, hsm_attest). Assigned: Maya/Liam/Omar. Deadline: 2025-03-07 16:00 UTC.
Aria (customer-sre): Peregrine prefers redacted artifacts delivered via pre-signed s3 link. Can we do that?
Maya (sec-eng): Yes. We'll stage artifacts to s3://compliance-evidence/peregrine-3410002222/ and share presigned links. I'll assemble the executive summary and redaction checklist once samples are in.
Liam (infra): Uploading RBAC sample now. DMing Maya link.
Omar (platform): KMS sample uploaded, vendor attestation attached. Sent to Maya via DM.
Maya (sec-eng): Thanks team. I'll compile and post draft to the private reviewer channel by EOD PT. If Peregrine asks for live attestation during the call, we're ready to escalate to vendor.
